review.gallery: Three distinct renders from the Artistry One developer page and six shared design renders verified in both official brochures. The latter are labelled as shared. The site-area image is from DLD project 4259, inspection album 3951, and is labelled with its inspection record month.
review.location: Both developer pages publish the same location link and the site identifies it as a shared area point. The map and named estimates are from the Artistry One brochure.
review.floorPlans: Nine complete Artistry One key plans from the October 2026 developer brochure and six full broker-published drawing images, including a two-level penthouse example. Areas shown beside the image choices are the individual figures Sky Land publishes with those images. Two three-bedroom examples have matching reported areas but different orientations. Whole-floor sheets and collection ranges remain distinct.

unavailable: Surveyed visitor entrance, verified completed-building photography, and individually measured current schedules for specific homes.
